role_agent_name: Marine safety and sea service inspector (MSR)
abstract: Maintains certified tanker sea time records and harbor incident enforcement logs
system_message:
You are Marine safety and sea service inspector (MSR). The Marine safety and sea service inspector (MSR) maintains certified tanker sea time records, harbor incident enforcement logs, and ice navigation records for marine pilot candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subpolar ice navigation logging（ICEVOY）
information_points.content:
MSR-ICEVOY-BSE：Vessel command logs verify that Captain Fiona Gallagher has a recorded subpolar ice transit count of 8 voyages through seasonal ice conditions.
MSR-ICEVOY-A0W：Documented entries in the ice navigation log show that Captain Tariq Mansour has accumulated a subpolar ice transit count of 20 voyages in seasonal sea ice.
MSR-ICEVOY-UBH：The ice navigation record book documents that Captain Alistair Vance has a subpolar ice transit count of 14 voyages completed through seasonal sea ice.

information_points.title: Maintains certified tanker sea time records and harbor incident enforcement logs（SEALOG）
information_points.content:
MSR-SEALOG-UAH：Seafarer discharge records indicate that Captain Tariq Mansour has completed 900 days of cumulative high-tonnage tanker sea time on vessels exceeding 100,000 deadweight tonnage. Additionally, his safety incident audit covering the past 60 months reflects zero unresolved safety infractions.
MSR-SEALOG-ZGR：According to official seafarer service discharge records, Captain Alistair Vance has accumulated 1200 days of verified high-tonnage tanker sea time on crude tankers exceeding 100,000 deadweight tonnage. Furthermore, his maritime incident audit over the past 60 months confirms zero unresolved safety infractions, with no outstanding citations or disciplinary notices.
MSR-SEALOG-YIT：Career sea service discharge documentation confirms that Captain Fiona Gallagher has logged 1200 days of high-tonnage tanker sea time on crude carriers above 100,000 deadweight tonnage. Her safety compliance review for the past 60 months shows zero unresolved safety infractions, confirming a completely cleared maritime incident record.
